    • updateConfigurationRegistry

      public void updateConfigurationRegistry(ConfigurationStrategy.Configuration configuration)
      Makes configuration available to code running in this sandbox through ConfigurationRegistry.

      TestEnvironment.setUpApplicationState(String, ConfigurationStrategy.Configuration, AndroidManifest) populates the registry for each test, but code can run in the sandbox before that, e.g. @BeforeClass methods and class rules. Loading a class whose shadow is chosen by a ShadowPicker that reads the registry (such as the graphics shadows, which depend on GraphicsMode) would otherwise fail, and leave the class unusable for the lifetime of the sandbox.
